desc: Prove that sorting descending and increasing any one index cannot increase the expression.
Design the max-heap state as `(value, i, j, k)` and derive the expression calculation using 64-bit integers.
Specify visited-state handling to avoid inserting the same `(i, j, k)` from multiple paths.
Verify complexity is `O(N log N + K log K)` time and `O(K)` memory.
Implement robust stdin/stdout parsing, the heap traversal, and sample-case verification.
